question: Operator step with a LocationIQ account: sign up once with a free-mail address and record whether the form accepts it as the 'Work email' or rejects it, then make one keyed geocode (us1.locationiq.com/v1/search) and one keyed route and record each HTTP status and the Balance endpoint's request count.
why: The form labels the field 'Work email' and its markup has only a required email-type input; the server-side rule on free-mail addresses and the keyed answers are behind a sign-up.
